title: Mobile Mechanic Preventive Maintenance Checklist Form
subtitle: Control mobile diagnosis, vehicle stabilization, repair, testing, and return or tow decision through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete mobile mechanic service preventive maintenance checklist for vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls. It connects approved repair scope, service information, and site plan to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified mobile mechanic must perform scheduled mobile mechanic service maintenance against an identified plan while preserving readings, defects, deferrals, verification, and the next due event.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic preventive service tasks and controlled materials
sections.guidance: Separate tasks completed from tasks merely considered, and preserve product, part, quantity, and removed-item custody.

blocks.label: Preventive maintenance tasks completed
items: Secure the vehicle and establish the mobile work zone
Control ignition, keys, battery, high voltage, pressure, heat, and movement
Perform approved scan, test, and physical diagnosis
Lift and support only at verified points when required
Repair or replace the authorized component
Service approved fluid, filter, battery, tire, or wear item
Apply required torque, adjustment, and configuration
Check for leaks, loose parts, tools, and foreign material
Complete stationary and limited functional tests
Decide return to service, restricted movement, recovery, or tow

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic measurements and post-maintenance verification
sections.guidance: Use repeatable observations to show the maintained scope reached the stated condition.

blocks.label: Measurement and verification log
blocks.guidance: Applicable measurement concepts include: Diagnostic code or scan value, Voltage, current, resistance, or battery test, Pressure, vacuum, compression, or temperature, Fluid level, leak, or service quantity, Torque, clearance, wear, tread, or brake measurement, Stationary, functional, roadworthiness, or recovery result.

blocks.label: Post-maintenance condition and function checks
items: Reported symptom and diagnostic result are reconciled
Vehicle is stable, complete, and free of tools or loose material
No uncontrolled leak, smoke, odor, fire, pressure, or electrical concern remains
Installed parts, fluids, fasteners, torque, and configuration are documented
Brakes, steering, tires, wheels, lights, and required controls support the decision
Warning lamps, diagnostic codes, and functional tests are documented
Roadworthiness decision identifies any restriction, recovery, or tow requirement
Customer or fleet representative accepted the vehicle and limitations

Torque, adjustment, calibration, or configuration reference
Leak, stationary, functional, and roadworthiness test
Return-to-service, restriction, recovery, or tow handoff

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic defect containment and corrective-action routing
sections.guidance: A preventive checklist does not release an unsafe, unverified, or out-of-scope condition.

blocks.label: Mobile Mechanic exception and stop-work indicators
items: Traffic, shoulder, grade, weather, lighting, or escape path is unsafe
Vehicle cannot be parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, or protected
Jack, stand, lift point, cribbing, or ground capacity is uncertain
Unexpected start, movement, pressure, heat, electrical, or high-voltage energy
Fuel, vapor, battery, fire, hot-surface, fluid, refrigerant, or spill concern
Tire, spring, air system, hydraulic system, or other stored energy uncontrolled
Service information, recall status, torque, calibration, or part compatibility uncertain
Repair exceeds mobile capability, available tools, environment, or authorization
Roadworthiness, braking, steering, tire, wheel, lighting, or structural condition uncertain
Customer requests driving or operation before required testing or tow decision
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic preventive maintenance checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This mobile mechanic service preventive maintenance checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when traffic, vehicle support, lifting, stored energy, high voltage, fuel, fire, weather, spill, repair information, or roadworthiness condition is uncertain. A automotive or fleet safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
